title: Remote podcast setup
subtitle: Record guests well, then turn episodes into clips and members
sections: Riverside records each person locally and uploads separate tracks.
Mic 5-10 cm from your mouth; quiet, soft room.
Cut 3 clips per episode for Shorts and TikTok.
Spotify Memberships: 100 listeners + 100 hours in 30 days; you keep 90%.
Riverside affiliate: up to 20% per subscription.
sources: Spotify newsroom: Memberships for creators (20 Oct 2026)
